headline: Vivimed Labs Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process initiated
sum: Vivimed Labs Limited, a pharmaceutical manufacturer listed on NSE, has initiated Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code. The company disclosed the proceedings via NSE filing on 17 August 2026.
implication: CIRP filing by a listed pharma entity triggers mandatory disclosure obligations under SEBI LODR and suspension/delisting risk; creditors must file claims within statutory timeline, and resolution professional will manage operations during 180-day (extendable) resolution window.
detail: Vivimed Labs Limited, a pharmaceutical manufacturing company, has been admitted into Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT). The company issued a notice to the stock exchange pursuant to its continuous disclosure obligations under SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements. The CIRP process, governed by the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, will involve identification of a resolution professional, submission of claims by creditors, and efforts to achieve a resolution plan within the statutory timeline.
